_about: The limits and patterns of tools/report-scan.mjs (Tools, 2026-11-23; path to Alpha 1 job 14: 'a size limit on the report and a scan of it for names and folder paths'; X-21: the report file must fit Discord's free upload limit). The report is the folder the game makes (match files in user://reports and, when UI's grant lands, the newest logs). UI ports `redact` to the game with these same patterns, so a copied log is cleaned before it is written; this tool is what proves the folder is clean after the fact (a test, CI on a made report, and a person's own check).
discordNote: Discord's free (non-Nitro) upload limit is 20 MB per file since 13 August 2026 (it was 10 MB; Neowin, https://www.neowin.net/news/discord-raises-file-size-upload-limit-for-its-non-subscribers/, quoting Discord's announcement; Discord's own help page was not read by Tools: re-check it before the guide is final). The limits below stay well under it so a report still goes if the limit is read as 10 MB.
perFileNote: 4 MB a file and 9 MB for the whole folder (under the old 10 MB limit as well as the new 20 MB one). A half-hour match's replay is the largest file the game writes; a log is cut to its last 200 KB by the copy.

windowsUserFolder.why: a Windows user's folder: the account name

posixHome.why: a user's home folder: the account name

driveRoot.why: a path on a drive of this PC

uncShare.why: a network share: a PC name

allowLines._about: Lines that look like a hit and are not: the engine's own banner and version lines. Matched against the whole line.
